name: Sample Pages 8 — Resume Builder (Design)
source: User-provided screenshot export from Figma (Sample Full-Screen Modal Builder - 2). Node ID not captured.
description: Resume Builder full-screen modal, Design mode. Same modal chrome and toolbar as the Editor view, but with the 'Design' tab active (and 'Editor' inactive). Left sidebar becomes 'Customize Your Template': stacked white cards with dropdown setting rows (Template, Margin, Spacing, Customization). Right preview canvas is identical to the Editor view.
note: Same shell (fullscreen Browser modal), modal-header and builder-body preview column as page-07. Only the mode-toolbar active tab and the left sidebar differ.

shell.note: Identical to page-07: full-screen DefaultBrowser modal, size fullscreen.

modal-header.note: Identical to page-07 modal-header (panel-section HeaderTitle 'Resume Builder' + close X).

mode-toolbar.note: Same structure as page-07. Tab states flipped: 'Editor' inactive (system.text-mute), 'Design' active.

right.note: Same as page-07: Save Template split button (Outlined) + Download (Filled)

customize-sidebar.description: Design settings sidebar. Sticky header row 'Customize Your Template' (text-styles.bold.body-md, system.text-head, border-bottom system.border-soft). Body on system.surface-soft canvas: stacked setting cards, each a white card (corner-radius.md, border system.border-soft) with a card title row (icon + label, text-styles.bold.body-sm) and setting rows underneath. Each setting row: label left (text-styles.regular.body-sm, system.text-body) + inline dropdown value right (Input type Dropdown, current value shown, e.g. 'Modern Professional').

preview-canvas.note: Identical to page-07 preview-canvas: system.surface-strong canvas + document-gallery ModernProfessional page card + vertical scroll-bar.

customElementsRegistry.builder-mode-toolbar: Basic icon+text tabs (Editor/Design) left; Save Template split button + Download filled button right. (shared with page-07)
customElementsRegistry.builder-body: Two-column: 330px sidebar + preview canvas. (shared with page-07)
customElementsRegistry.template-customize-sidebar: Stacked white setting cards; each row = label + inline Dropdown value. Card border: system.border-soft, radius corner-radius.md.

geometry.modal: fullscreen browser EModal, same shell as page-07
geometry.toolbar: same as page-07 with Design segment active

sidebar.body: gray surface-strong, 4 white cards (Template / Margin / Spacing / Customization)

geometry.canvas: same as page-07 (blue tint #dbeafe, A4 595x842 paper)

_provenance.method: same pixel-scan basis as page-07; card/row geometry read from 2x crops
notes: dropdown rows are demo interactions: click cycles through preset options
